name: Pinzano al Tagliamento (Italy)
description: Divided per saltire, white at the hoist and fly and black at the top and bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Pinzano al Tagliamento, a comune in Friuli Venezia Giulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.
